versos.texto_bv: E os peixes, que estão no rio, morrerão, e o rio cheirará mal; e os egípcios vão se cansar, procurando beber água do rio.
versos.traducao_literal: E o peixe que no Nilo morrerá, e federá o Nilo, e cansar-se-ão os egípcios de beber água do Nilo.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): BV traduz 'vão se cansar, procurando beber' para o hebraico que, na forma negativa com יכל (yachal), significa 'não conseguirão/não suportarão beber'. As três referências convergem em sentido de repulsa ou incapacidade: ARA 'terão nojo de beber', NVIPT 'não suportarão beber', NTLH 'terão nojo de beber'. 'Cansar' transmite fadiga/esforço, não repulsa ou incapacidade — divergência semântica em relação ao original e a todas as referências. — evidência: ARA: 'terão nojo de beber da água do rio'; NVIPT: 'não suportarão beber das suas águas'; NTLH: 'terão nojo de beber água dele'. Todas expressam repulsa ou incapacidade; nenhuma expressa cansaço.

kjv.texto: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

vizinhos.17: Thus saith the Lord, In this thou shalt know that I am the Lord: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
vizinhos.19: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.

web.texto: The fish that are in the river shall die, and the river shall become foul; and the Egyptians shall loathe to drink water from the river.”’”

vizinhos.17: Thus says Yahweh, “In this you shall know that I am Yahweh. Behold, I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
vizinhos.19: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood; and there shall be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”
